title: Archive and Signal
author: Mara Voss
blurb: Kestrel Okonkwo, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
